newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint unmoved by NBH depo rate changes.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint unmoved by NBH depo rate changes.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended Monday little changed against the dollar in quiet trade unaffected by the central bank's decisions to raise six-month commercial bank deposit rates and introduce a new 12-month facility.
The forint closed at 176.87/92 against the U.S. unit compared to a midday level of 176.90/95 and an opening 176.86/91.

"There was hardly any interest today and certainly no effect from the NBH decisions although they came as a surprise," said Balazs Benczedi of WestLB Hungaria, adding that he expects a similarly low-key picture for Tuesday's forex market.
"I expect the forint to keep its small 10 to 20 filler gap from the NBH resistance level," he said.

The NBH on Monday raised the rate at which it accepts deposits from the commercial banks for six months to 21.00 percent from 20.75 and also announced a new 12-month deposit facility at 20.50 percent interest.
